desc: Derive/verify the edge-contribution probabilities for a query u<v: x<u -> 2(x-1)/(x(x+1)), x=u -> (u-1)/u, u<x<v -> 1/x, x=v -> 1, otherwise 0.
Implement the O(N+Q) Python solution using pref1/pref2, modular inverses, and fact=(N-1)!, with the query formula above.
Test the implementation on the provided samples and small brute-force cross-checks (N<=7, edge cases u=1, v=u+1, N=2), then finalize the code.
